root_family.canonical_name: Professional Legal, Financial, Audit & Advisory Services
root_family.definition: Chartered certified accounting and auditing, Ethiopian corporate tax filing, commercial law contract preparation, and business feasibility studies.

translations.am: የህግ፣ የኦዲት፣ የግብር እና የሂሳብ አያያዝ አገልግሎቶች
translations.ti: ናይ ሕጊ፣ ኦዲት፣ ግብርን ሒሳብን ኣገልግሎት

children.canonical_name: Chartered Accounting, Tax Filing & External Audit Services
children.definition: Certified audit reports, monthly VAT/TOT declarations to Ministry of Revenues, and statutory business financial statements.

translations.am: የውጭ ኦዲት፣ የታክስ እና የቫት ማሳወቂያ አገልግሎት
